purpose: Export a 10-vector direction-by-cardinality grouped-MLP6/7 displacement program from the second corpus, then prospectively test whether it can replace each third-corpus target displacement and preserve the signed causal margin computation through frozen readers.

selection_screen.finding: Factor-specific LOO prototypes beat direction-cardinality by only 2.52% SSE, rejecting the 32-vector table and selecting the 10-vector law.

novelty_audit: Searches for direction-cardinality prototype, cardinality displacement, upstream prototype, prototype native effect, and target-free displacement found only the immediately preceding retrospective selector screen.
Prior fixed-reader transfer predicts effects of each target text's own native displacement. This candidate exports fixed upstream vectors and installs them on entirely new text.
The 10-vector candidate is selected against a 32-vector factor-specific law before this third corpus exists; a two-vector direction-only program is the matched simpler control.
program: On the second corpus, average all 1152-D exact-minus-base L11H3 displacements separately for direction d and cardinality k over all rows and all E/A/U/W subsets of size k, exporting p[d,k]. Also export p[d,*] averaged over all subsets as a direction-only control. On each new target row/subset, install h_base+p[d,k] or h_base+p[d,*]. No target exact displacement is used by either prototype method. Frozen reader g[d] seals predicted prototype effects g[d] dot p before any new causal lattice is opened.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_artifact: The frozen 32-row/96-endpoint authority, native capability license, reader artifact, training authority, prototype artifact, temporal prediction seal, and all decomposition closures validate.
predictions.pred_b_reader_predicts_installed_prototy: Across all 512 cardinality-prototype installations, frozen-reader predictions versus observed prototype causal effects have cosine >=0.90, relative L2 error <=0.45, and sign agreement >=0.85.
predictions.pred_c_prototype_substitutes_native_disp: Observed cardinality-prototype effects versus the target text's native exact-minus-base effects have cosine >=0.75, relative L2 error <=0.75, and sign agreement >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_intermediate_and_each_template_tr: The 448 intermediate subsets independently meet cosine >=0.70, relative L2 error <=0.85, signs >=0.70; each new template meets cosine >=0.65, relative L2 error <=0.90, signs >=0.65 against native effects.
predictions.pred_e_cardinality_beats_direction_only: Cardinality prototypes reduce SSE to native causal effects by at least 10% versus the two-vector direction-only program on identical installations.
predictions.pred_f_target_free_program_and_price: Prototype writes and sealed predictions never consume a third-corpus exact displacement or causal outcome; no fit/scale/offset/update occurs. Export stores exactly 12x1152=13824 scalars; validation uses the registered managed price.

null: Failure of b means the fixed downstream reader is not adequate for these exported writes. Failure of c-d means upstream displacements are too text-specific for this fixed program. Failure of e means cardinality is unnecessary and the two-vector program should be tested without post-hoc rescue. Preserve every miss and do not tune prototypes or bars on the third corpus.
